set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- Canonical whole-buffer copies use primitive array or matching typed-array bulk transfer.
- C-contiguous offset subviews use a raw range copy without logical callback traversal.
- General strided, reversed, transposed, and broadcast layouts retain exact logical C-order through dtype-specialized fallbacks.
- Copy APIs never expose an owned backing buffer or create a borrowed result accidentally.
- Every supported dtype, including unsigned storage and the documented Scala.js Long representation, has JVM and Scala.js correctness coverage.
- Empty arrays, scalar arrays, offset views, negative strides, zero strides, and overlapping external destinations have explicit behavior and tests.
- Allocation and timing receipts demonstrate the fast path and report every regression; public interop signatures remain source compatible.
set.title: Add bulk JVM and Scala.js interop copy fast paths
